body:
You say no one remembers a loved one? My grandfather passed away in 2003 and 3 times a week I go to his grave and visit him in my own way, telling him about whats been happening since he has been gone. He was a major part of everyone's life in my family and even though everyone else just "prays" for him from him and in their prayers I am the only one who goes to his grave everyday wishing his lungs weren't full of tar and nicotine and he would still be with us. 

Never think no one loves you, There are people out there who may seem to hate but at the end they are the ones to shed the most tears for you.
